scope: Human Technology Brokers, permanent unlocks, material-priced one-copy purchases, pre-engineered human modules, Sirius/Azimuth special equipment, and current AX support modules used by the Mongrels Field Manual and Ask the Mongrels.

entries.topic: Human Tech Brokers: Unlocks vs One-Copy Purchases
entries.ruleOfThumb: Before spending materials, identify whether the item is a permanent unlock or a one-copy purchase. Permanent unlocks become credit-purchasable afterward; pre-engineered purchases consume the listed resources for every copy.
details: Human Technology Brokers mix multiple acquisition models in the same interface.
Traditional unlocks permanently add an item to the eligible Outfitting catalogue after the one-time resource payment.
Pre-engineered and special-purchase items instead place one module into local storage; another copy requires another full resource payment.
Bring every required commodity/material at once; broker requirements are not paid in installments.

entries.ruleOfThumb: The classic Human broker items are true unlocks: pay the resource cost once, then buy copies for credits from qualifying Outfitting services.
details: Permanent Human unlock families include the Class 4 Corrosion Resistant Cargo Rack, Enzyme Missile Rack, Meta Alloy Hull Reinforcement, Remote Release Flechette Launcher variants and Shock Cannon variants.
Weapon mount/class variants can require their own unlock rather than one payment covering the whole weapon family.
These legacy broker items differ from V1/pre-engineered modules, which generally charge materials per copy.

sources.name: Elite Dangerous Wiki — Remote Release Flechette Launcher

entries.ruleOfThumb: For pre-engineered broker purchases, materials are the price of the module. Paying once gives one copy in local storage, not a permanent credit unlock.
details: Examples include Engineered DSS V1, Engineered FSD V1, Engineered FSD (SCO) V1, Engineered Seeker Missile Rack V1 and Modified Mining Laser.
Sirius and Azimuth special equipment also commonly uses the one-copy purchase model.
If a build needs two or four copies, multiply the full material recipe accordingly before traveling to the broker.

entries.ruleOfThumb: The legacy 5A Engineered FSD V1 is a per-copy broker purchase with both Increased Range and Faster Boot Sequence. Do not overwrite its primary engineering if you want to keep the double-mod advantage.
details: Each purchase costs 18 Datamined Wake Exceptions, 26 Tellurium, 26 Electrochemical Arrays and 28 Chemical Processors.
One payment places one 5A drive into local storage; more copies require more materials.
The paired primary modifications make it outperform a normally engineered 5A FSD for jump range.
An Experimental Effect can be added/replaced without removing the unique double primary modification; applying a different primary blueprint destroys the special combination.

sources.name: Elite Dangerous Wiki — Frame Shift Drive / Pre-Engineered FSD V1

entries.ruleOfThumb: The V1 SCO drives are the modern long-range option across Classes 2A-7A. Each copy costs materials plus one Titan Drive Component.
details: V1 SCO drives combine Increased Range and Faster Boot Sequence and retain Supercruise Overcharge capability.
Each class has a separate material recipe and every purchase requires one Titan Drive Component.
The purchased drive appears in local storage and another copy requires another full payment.
Experimental Effects can be applied normally; preserve the paired primary modifications.

sources.name: Elite Dangerous Wiki — Frame Shift Drive (SCO)

entries.ruleOfThumb: For exploration, the Engineered DSS V1 is the broker version to buy: its +40% probe radius is stronger than ordinary single-blueprint DSS engineering.
details: The V1 DSS uses a special doubled Expanded Probe Scanning Radius effect for +40% probe radius.
A normally engineered DSS reaches +30% with the regular G5 blueprint.
Each V1 scanner is a separate material purchase and is placed in local storage.
Its recipe is 24 Niobium, 28 Mechanical Components, 22 Germanium and 26 Mechanical Scrap.

sources.name: Elite Dangerous Wiki — Detailed Surface Scanner

entries.ruleOfThumb: The Engineered Seeker V1 is a per-copy special weapon with Lightweight, High Capacity and Thermal Cascade already installed; plan around that package because it cannot be further engineered normally.
details: The special Class 2 fixed launcher carries multiple pre-applied effects that cannot be recreated as a normal engineering stack.
Each purchase requires 10 Osmium, 24 Conductive Ceramics, 26 Hybrid Capacitors, 28 Phosphorus and 16 Proto Radiolic Alloys.
One payment grants one launcher in local storage.

sources.name: Elite Dangerous Wiki — Seeker Missile Rack

entries.ruleOfThumb: The Modified Mining Laser is a per-copy Class 1 special laser valued for 2.5 km range and reduced power/distributor load, not raw mining DPS.
details: Its maximum range is 2,500 m, far beyond the normal small Mining Laser.
It has lower power/distributor draw and heat but slightly lower damage/mining output per laser.
The special modifications cannot be re-applied by Engineers after removal.
Each copy costs 16 Osmium, 20 Arsenic, 24 Rhenium and 28 Phosphorus.

sources.name: Elite Dangerous Wiki — Mining Laser / Modified Mining Laser

entries.ruleOfThumb: The Sirius Heat Sink Launcher is a per-copy pre-engineered launcher with enhanced ammo capacity. Budget materials for every launcher you want.
details: Each purchase places one Sirius launcher into local storage rather than permanently unlocking unlimited credit copies.
The current broker recipe is 8 Mechanical Scrap, 6 Niobium, 6 Vanadium and 5 Mechanical Components.
The special pre-engineered effect cannot be recreated by normal Engineers after removal.
This is especially useful on heat-intensive AX, stealth and emergency-support builds.

sources.name: Elite Dangerous Wiki — Heatsink Launcher / Sirius Heatsink Launcher

keywords: high capacity rapid fire ax missile
entries.ruleOfThumb: Sirius AX Missile Racks are per-copy material purchases, not a one-time family unlock. They come pre-engineered with High Capacity and Rapid Fire.
details: Fixed Medium and Fixed Large variants use separate recipes.
Every copy consumes its full Sirius broker material cost.
The Large recipe also includes Technetium in addition to manufactured/raw engineering materials.
Do not confuse these with ordinary Enhanced AX Missile Racks sold for credits.

sources.name: Elite Dangerous Wiki — AX Missile Rack

entries.ruleOfThumb: Azimuth Enhanced AX Multi-cannons are special gimballed Medium/Large per-copy broker purchases. They are not the same as ordinary Enhanced AX Multi-cannons sold for credits.
details: The Azimuth variants are bought one copy at a time with engineering/Thargoid materials.
Medium and Large versions have different recipes; the Large recipe additionally uses Ship Systems Data.
Ordinary Enhanced AX Multi-cannons exist as standard outfitting modules and should not be confused with the Azimuth material-purchase versions.

entries.ruleOfThumb: Use a Corrosion Resistant Cargo Rack for corrosive Thargoid cargo such as Titan Drive Components. The broker Class 4 rack is a permanent Human Tech Broker unlock.
details: The Class 4 rack can be permanently unlocked at a Human Technology Broker, then purchased for credits at eligible Outfitting services.
Corrosive Thargoid objects can damage a ship if carried in ordinary cargo racks.
Class 1 corrosion-resistant racks are also sold through specific Engineer locations; larger historical CG variants are not generally unlockable.

sources.name: Elite Dangerous Wiki — Corrosion Resistant Cargo Rack

entries.topic: Shock Cannon, Flechette & Enzyme Missile Unlocks
entries.ruleOfThumb: Shock Cannons, Remote Release Flechette Launchers and the Enzyme Missile Rack are legacy Human broker unlocks. Unlock the exact mount/class you need rather than farming every variant blindly.
details: Shock Cannon variants are permanently unlocked individually and then purchased for credits at Human Tech Broker Outfitting.
Remote Release Flechette fixed/turreted variants are separate permanent unlocks.
The Enzyme Missile Rack is another permanent Human broker weapon unlock.
These experimental weapons are generally niche; build planning should come before material farming.

sources.name: Elite Dangerous Wiki — Remote Release Flechette Launcher

entries.topic: Caustic Sink Launcher & Thargoid Pulse Neutraliser: Current Access
entries.ruleOfThumb: Do not follow old material-unlock guides for these two modules. Frontier removed their Tech Broker material requirements on 29 February 2024 so pilots could outfit for Titan combat more easily.
details: Frontier officially removed the broker requirements for the Thargoid Pulse Neutraliser and Caustic Sink Launcher in February 2024.
They remain associated with Rescue Ship / Rescue Megaship outfitting rather than ordinary Human broker progression.
The Caustic Sink absorbs caustic contamination and can be restocked at stations or via synthesis.
Older guides showing tissue samples, unclassified relics or other unlock recipes describe the pre-February-2024 system.

sources.name: Frontier — Titan Combat Rewards & Changes (29 Feb 2024)
Elite Dangerous Wiki — Caustic Sink Launcher
Elite Dangerous Wiki — Thargoid Pulse Neutraliser

entries.ruleOfThumb: The Experimental Weapon Stabiliser increases the number of experimental/AX weapons a ship can equip: Class 3 raises the limit to five and Class 5 raises it to six.
details: This is a normal special outfitting module rather than a material-priced Human Tech Broker unlock.
The Class 3 version permits five experimental weapons total; the Class 5 version permits six.
Use the stabiliser only when the extra AX hardpoints justify sacrificing an optional internal slot.

sources.name: Frontier Galnet — Experimental Weapons Stabiliser Becomes Available
